name: NYC PolicyScope — Generate Newsletter Images
description: Triggered by nanoclaw webhook. Calls scripts/generate_image.py which uses Google Imagen 2 API. Returns raw PNG paths — no Gemini logo.

nodes.name: Webhook: Generate Images
Run generate_image.py
nodes.notes:
Calls scripts/generate_image.py with --json flag.
Returns JSON with image file paths.
Images saved to data/output/images/ as raw PNG — no visible logo.
Requires GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY in environment.
